fixture.declaredCircleRule: A circle is approximated by a polygon of 4 x steps vertices inscribed in it. The area of such a polygon is (n / 2π) sin(2π / n) of the circle’s, which is 0.99960 at 128 vertices.

criterion: exactly 128 vertices, the reported circle-area fraction within 5e-05 of the closed form for an inscribed polygon, and every vertex within 0.001 m of the stated 500 m on the sphere of radius 6.37101e+06 m that Turf buffers on
notEstablished: That a 500 m buffer is 500 m on the ground. It is 500 m on a sphere of radius 6,371,008.8 m and 500.28 to 501.59 m on the WGS84 ellipsoid at this latitude -- up to 1.59 m more, varying with direction. That is a property of the construction, reported rather than corrected. Nor whether the radius is the right radius: a buffered scope is a decision, not a surveyed boundary.
